Rejected as authority-grade proof because no source path creates/updates outgoing KSeF records or saves UPO files, phpunit is disabled in CI, no KSeF semantic tests exist, and no immutable XSD/API/client manifest is stored.

best_result: Found a real ISP ERP whose FA(3) invoices self-identify the official schema and whose database/UPO UI models regulator evidence, then falsified the stronger end-to-end claim: the public revision does not contain the outgoing submission/session/UPO writer or semantic KSeF tests. This adds an executable-component provenance requirement to CAP-008/CAP-019.
